title: Dedicated senior support services
summary: This document describes the bank’s Dedicated Senior Support services (access status: Yes), covering account access help, debit card (lost/stolen, replacement, travel notices, PIN guidance), check requests (reorders/status), unauthorized transaction disputes, payments/transfers setup changes/troubleshooting, statement preferences/document requests, profile updates, fraud prevention guidance, and accessibility/relay coordination.
faqs: How do I contact the dedicated senior support team (phone, secure message, or call-back)?
What help can I get with debit card issues like lost/stolen, replacement, travel notices, or PIN guidance?
Can they help with check reorders and status of recent check orders?
How do I initiate a dispute for unauthorized transactions?
What information should I have ready for identity verification (name, account number, ID, request details)?
What security tips should I follow when speaking with support (passwords, one-time passcodes, unexpected calls)?
keywords: Debit card support (lost/stolen, replacement, travel notices, PIN guidance)
Check-related requests (reorders, status of recent orders)
Payments and transfers support (set up, changes, troubleshooting)
Call-back via digital banking contact options
